# VOIP Accelerator

> Local-first rate deck analysis and comparison for VOIP operators, wholesale carriers, and telecom pricing/LCR teams. Compare US NPANXX rate decks, enrich with LERG data, reprice down to the NPA, and export reports — entirely in the browser. Free.

VOIP Accelerator is a web app for telecom pricing and least-cost-routing teams. Rate decks are parsed locally in the browser and never uploaded to a server, so carrier pricing stays private. It focuses on US NPANXX rate decks: compare two decks to find coverage gaps and cherry-picked margin, enrich numbers with LERG (state / jurisdiction) context, reprice with markup/markdown rules, and export reports — in minutes instead of a day in Excel.

Key facts:
- Local-first: decks are parsed in the browser; nothing is uploaded to a server.
- Focus: US NPANXX, LERG-enriched and jurisdiction-aware (interstate / intrastate / indeterminate).
- Accepts both CSV and XLSX rate decks.
- Free to use; no deck upload and no sales call required to try it.
